Package com.neueda.leap.onboarding.dto

Record Class RegisterUserRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.neueda.leap.onboarding.dto.RegisterUserRequest
Record Components:
firstName - the user's first name
lastName - the user's last name
dateOfBirth - the user's birth date; applicant must be at least 21
email - the user's email address
phone - the user's phone number
password - the raw password provided during registration
streetAddress - the first address line
apartment - the second address line (optional)
city - the user's city
stateProvince - the user's state or province
postalCode - the user's postal/ZIP code
country - the user's country of residence
citizenshipStatus - the user's citizenship or residency status
ssn - the user's social security number in 9-digit or 123-45-6789 format (optional)
employmentStatus - the user's employment status
employerName - the employer or business name when employed/self-employed
occupation - the occupation when employed/self-employed
annualIncome - the annual income amount as a string value
netWorthBracket - the selected net worth bracket
riskProfile - the selected risk profile
liquidityPosition - the liquid assets amount as a string value
accreditedInvestor - whether the user self-identifies as accredited
accountName - the display name for the account
accountType - the account type value
traderLevel - the selected trader level
politicallyExposedPerson - whether the user is a politically exposed person
brokerAffiliation - whether the user is affiliated with a broker-dealer
brokerFirmName - affiliated broker firm name when broker affiliation is true
brokerAffiliationDetails - affiliation details when broker affiliation is true
controlPerson - whether the user is a control person of a public company
controlCompanyName - company name when control person is true
controlCompanyRole - role at the company when control person is true
otherBeneficialOwner - whether someone else is the beneficial owner
beneficialOwnerName - beneficial owner's name when another owner exists
beneficialOwnerRelationship - beneficial owner's relationship when another owner exists
public record RegisterUserRequest(@NotBlank @Size(max=100) String firstName, @NotBlank @Size(max=100) String lastName, @NotNull LocalDate dateOfBirth, @NotBlank @Email @Size(max=320) String email, @Size(max=30) String phone, @NotBlank @Size(min=8,max=128) String password, @NotBlank @Size(max=255) String streetAddress, @Size(max=255) String apartment, @NotBlank @Size(max=100) String city, @NotBlank @Size(max=100) String stateProvince, @NotBlank @Size(max=20) String postalCode, @NotBlank @Size(max=100) String country, @NotNull CitizenshipStatus citizenshipStatus, @Pattern(regexp="^(\\d{9}|\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4})?$",message="SSN must be 9 digits or 123-45-6789") String ssn, @NotNull EmploymentStatus employmentStatus, @Size(max=255) String employerName, @Size(max=100) String occupation, @NotBlank @Size(max=32) String annualIncome, @NotNull NetWorthBracket netWorthBracket, @NotNull RiskProfile riskProfile, @NotBlank @Size(max=32) String liquidityPosition, @NotNull Boolean accreditedInvestor, @NotBlank @Size(max=100) String accountName, @NotNull AccountType accountType, @NotNull TraderLevel traderLevel, @NotNull Boolean politicallyExposedPerson, @NotNull Boolean brokerAffiliation, @Size(max=255) String brokerFirmName, @Size(max=255) String brokerAffiliationDetails, @NotNull Boolean controlPerson, @Size(max=255) String controlCompanyName, @Size(max=255) String controlCompanyRole, @NotNull Boolean otherBeneficialOwner, @Size(max=255) String beneficialOwnerName, @Size(max=255) String beneficialOwnerRelationship) extends Record
Request DTO used to register a new user and complete investor onboarding fields.
